title: CHANGE PAD BUTTONS: CONTROLLER REBINDING
why: His order: controller rebinding is new. The CONTROLLER section of Settings has CHANGE PAD BUTTONS, a window like CHANGE KEYS for the pad. It lists the sixteen things a pad does in a raid (sprint, dodge roll, crouch, fire, the two focus aims, the aim distance pair, use and reload, the ring search, the two gun bumpers, the item wheel, the backpack, ping and map, pause) and the button each is on. Click REBIND, the row says PRESS A BUTTON, and the next button you press is the new one (a button still held from the click is waited out first, the press that binds does nothing else, and ESC or ten seconds cancels). If another action had that button, the two swap and the window says so. RESET TO DEFAULTS puts back his layout of 2026-09-27. In a raid the new button does the action and the old one no longer does, for taps, holds, triggers and bumpers alike; every prompt, the controls legend and the small pad legend name the new button, and they are saved in the profile; in the DEMO they hold for the session. The sticks stay as they are, and the menus, the title and the Undercroft keep the standard buttons, which the window says.
now: Controller has change pad buttons: rebind any pad action.
